entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was raining as my car came to a..."
entries.dialogueText: It was raining as my car came to a stop by the Holsord Grand Cemetery.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He offered to carry my umbrella."
entries.dialogueText: He offered to carry my umbrella.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I let him carry my umbrella."
entries.dialogueText: I let him carry my umbrella.
entries.menuText: Let him carry your umbrella.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Under the watchful eyes of security..."
entries.dialogueText: Under the watchful eyes of security officers, I started walking amidst the gravestones.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A small crowd of family and friends..."
entries.dialogueText: A small crowd of family and friends gathered around the final resting place of Serge Wolkner.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some in the media were calling him..."
entries.dialogueText: Some in the media were calling him a hero: the brave driver who saved the president by sacrificing his life. It was true.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked up to his widow, Suzan. I..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked up to his widow, Suzan. I had never met her in person before.

entries.title: Narrator: "Little Anton was crying silently ne..."
entries.dialogueText: Little Anton was crying silently next to his sister, Erica.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Little Georg was crying silently ne..."
entries.dialogueText: Little Georg was crying silently next to his sister, Erica.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were too young to experience t..."
entries.dialogueText: They were too young to experience the pain of losing a father.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked over to stand next to the..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked over to stand next to the priest, who stepped back upon my arrival.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Today, we are mourning a hero of o..."
entries.dialogueText: “Today, we are mourning a hero of our nation.”
entries.menuText: “Today, we are mourning a hero of our nation.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around at everyone's faces..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around at everyone's faces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite my protests, security would..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite my protests, security wouldn't permit a larger funeral.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Today, we are gathered here to mou..."
entries.dialogueText: “Today, we are gathered here to mourn the man who saved my life.”
entries.menuText: “Today, we have gathered here to mourn the man who saved my life.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Today, we are sending off a friend..."
entries.dialogueText: “Today, we are sending off a friend, a husband and a father.”
entries.menuText: “Today, we are sending off a friend, a husband and a father.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Serge Wolkner was a true Sord. He..."
entries.dialogueText: “Serge Wolkner was a true Sord. He was honest, proud and brave.”
entries.menuText: “Serge Wolkner was a true Sord. He was honest, proud and brave.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Serge Wolkner was more than a simp..."
entries.dialogueText: “Serge Wolkner was more than a simple driver for me. He was a real friend.”
entries.menuText: “Serge Wolkner was more than a simple driver for me. He was a real friend.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Serge Wolkner was loved by many an..."
entries.dialogueText: “Serge Wolkner was loved by many and he will be missed dearly.”
entries.menuText: “Serge Wolkner was loved by many and he will be missed dearly.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will always cherish the moments..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will always cherish the moments I spent with him.”
entries.menuText: “I will always cherish the moments I spent with him.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He has left us too soon.”"
entries.dialogueText: “He has left us too soon.”
entries.menuText: “He has left us too soon.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“His memory is engraved in our mind..."
entries.dialogueText: “His memory is engraved in our minds and hearts. We must remember him well.”
entries.menuText: “His memory is engraved in all of our minds and hearts. We must remember him well.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I wouldn't be able to find a singl..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't be able to find a single person who did not enjoy his company.”
entries.menuText: “I wouldn't be able to find a single person who did not enjoy his company.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will never forget that I am stan..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will never forget that I am standing here right now because of his sacrifice.”
entries.menuText: “I will never forget that I am standing here right now because of his sacrifice.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I will be forever burdened with th..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will be forever burdened with the fact that this happened because of me.”
entries.menuText: “I will be forever burdened with the fact that this happened because of me.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am granting him the title, 'Hero..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am granting him the title, 'Hero of Sordland'.”
entries.menuText: “I am granting him the title, 'Hero of Sordland'.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I swear to cherish the life he has..."
entries.dialogueText: “I swear to cherish the life he has once again granted me with.”
entries.menuText: “I swear to cherish the life he has once again granted me with.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“His death will be avenged. This, I..."
entries.dialogueText: “His death will be avenged. This, I promise.”
entries.menuText: “His death will be avenged. This, I promise.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The family he has left behind will..."
entries.dialogueText: “The family he has left behind will have the full support of the government.”
entries.menuText: “The family he has left behind will have the full support of the government.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am granting him the military ran..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am granting him the military rank of Major.”
entries.menuText: “I am granting him the military rank of Major.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“In these dark times, we need to co..."
entries.dialogueText: “In these dark times, we need to come together in unity.”
entries.menuText: “In these dark times, we need to come together in unity.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Farewell, brother.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Farewell, brother.”
entries.menuText: “Farewell, brother.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you for your service, Serge...."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your service, Serge.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you for your service, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“May his memory last forever.”"
entries.dialogueText: “May his memory last forever.”
entries.menuText: “May his memory last forever.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The casket started to be lowered."
entries.dialogueText: The casket started to be lowered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I put my hand in my pocket and pull..."
entries.dialogueText: I put my hand in my pocket and pulled out the watch Serge once gave me.

entries.dialogueText: I recalled that he said it protected his father from the evil of this world.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At first I didn't believe it, but n..."
entries.dialogueText: At first I didn't believe it, but now I did.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic

entries.dialogueText: I kept the watch and put it back in my pocket.
entries.menuText: Keep the watch.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I walked over to Serge's son and ga..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked over to Serge's son and gave him the watch.
entries.menuText: Give the watch to Serge's son.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I placed the watch on Serge's grave..."
entries.dialogueText: I placed the watch on Serge's grave.

entries.title: Narrator: "As the casket hit the ground, mourn..."
entries.dialogueText: As the casket hit the ground, mourners sprinkled handfuls of dirt on Serge's grave.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His wife and children hugged each o..."
entries.dialogueText: His wife and children hugged each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I realized it was time for me to le..."
entries.dialogueText: I realized it was time for me to leave.

entries.title: Player: "“Your father was a great man. Don't..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your father was a great man. Don't ever forget that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ms. Wolkner. I will never forget y..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ms. Wolkner. I will never forget your husband's service and his heroic sacrifice."
entries.menuText: “Ms. Wolkner. I will never forget your husband's service and his heroic sacrifice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am so sorry, Suzan.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am so sorry, Suzan.”
entries.menuText: “I am so sorry, Suzan.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My condolences.”"
entries.dialogueText: “My condolences.”
entries.menuText: “My condolences.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We hugged and she cried on my shoul..."
entries.dialogueText: We hugged and she cried on my shoulder. I crouched next to Serge's children.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You must be strong.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You must be strong.”
entries.menuText: “You must be strong.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I turned my back on Serge's fina..."
entries.dialogueText: As I turned my back on Serge's final resting place, I looked up at the dark clouds above.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: My new driver opened the door. I had forgotten his name already.
